### **1.1 Title & Overview**

**Does the title slide include all required identification information?**

The title slide should explicitly include:

* Company name (**JPMorgan Chase & Co.**)
* Fiscal period (**3Q21**)
* Announcement date (**October 13, 2021**)
* A short sentiment sub-header summarizing the main sentiment (e.g., "Strong Results Amid Economic Growth")

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which required element(s) are missing.

**Is there a clearly identifiable Executive Summary part immediately following the title?**

The Executive Summary should:

* Present high-level top-line figures
* Include Net Income and Earnings Per Share (EPS)
* Include Revenue (specifically mentioning Reported vs. Managed)
* Mention the impact of the Reserve Release

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which metrics or distinctions are missing.

**Is there a dedicated slide(s) presenting management commentary?**

This slide should:

* Include at least one quote from Jamie Dimon
* Cover topics regarding "economic growth," the "Delta variant/supply chain," or "credit reserve releases"
* Attribute quotes clearly to the CEO

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which executive perspective is missing.

**Does the leadership commentary clearly serve a strategic or narrative purpose?**

The slide should frame:

* The caution regarding "scenario-driven releases" not being core/recurring profits
* The context of the improving economic outlook despite dampening effects

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, describe how the narrative context is unclear or absent.

**Is there a slide summarizing income statement highlights year-over-year?**

The slide should cover:

* Net Revenue (Managed)
* Noninterest Expense
* Provision for Credit Losses
* Net Income
* Comparison with 3Q20

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which financial elements are missing.

**Is there a dedicated slide explaining the "Significant Items" (Reserve Release & Tax Benefit)?**

This slide should:

* Detail the **$2.1 billion net credit reserve release**
* Detail the **$566 million income tax benefit**
* Explicitly state the EPS impact of these items
* Present "Excluding significant items" Net Income to prevent misinterpretation

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify whether the significant items are missing or insufficiently explained.

**Is capital return to shareholders and "Fortress Principles" explicitly covered?**

The slides should mention:

* Dividends
* Net Repurchases
* Basel III CET1 Capital/Ratio and SLR (Supplementary Leverage Ratio)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify what aspect of capital allocation is missing.

**Is there a dedicated section covering all four business segments?**

The slides should separately cover:

* Consumer & Community Banking (CCB)
* Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB)
* Commercial Banking (CB)
* Asset & Wealth Management (AWM)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which segment(s) are missing.

**For each segment, are revenue and net income figures presented?**

Each segment should include:

* Net Revenue
* Net Income
* Year-over-year changes or growth trends

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which quantitative elements are missing for which segment.

**Are key segment-specific highlights listed?**

Expected coverage includes:

* Debit/Credit card sales volume (CCB)
* Global IB fees ranking and Markets revenue breakdown (CIB)
* Gross IB revenue and Commercial Real Estate trends (CB)
* Assets Under Management (AWM)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which business highlights are omitted.

**Is there a slide summarizing Business Expansion and Community Impact?**

This slide should:

* Mention branch expansion (lower 48 states) and/or UK digital launch
* List metrics on credit and capital raised (e.g., $2.4 trillion YTD)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, describe what operational or community context is missing.

**Is there a slide addressing forward-looking statements and risks?**

This slide should:

* Clearly state that actual results may differ
* Avoid inventing future guidance
* Maintain a neutral, disclaimer-style tone

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, explain what disclaimer content is missing.

**Is there a final slide providing contact and replay information?**

The slide should include:

* Investor Relations contact (Reggie Chambers)
* Media contact (Trish Wexler)
* Conference call/webcast details

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which closing information is absent.

**Does the slide deck include all required major sections in the prescribed order?**

Required sections include:

1. Title & Overview
2. Leadership Context
3. Financial Deep Dive
4. Segment Performance
5. Operational Highlights & Community Support
6. Closing & Disclaimers

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which section is missing, reordered, or merged incorrectly.
